audit_items.proof_trace: VerifyDataColumnSidecar accepts data column sidecars without checking len(KzgCommitments) <= max_blobs_per_block. While block processing enforces this limit (payload.go:238-241), P2P-received data columns bypass the check, allowing attackers to send sidecars with excessive commitments causing memory/CPU exhaustion in downstream batch verification.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker crafts DataColumnSidecar with 1000+ KzgCommitments (far exceeding max_blobs_per_block of 6-12) and gossips via P2P. Validation passes VerifyDataColumnSidecar, proceeds to VerifyDataColumnsSidecarKZGProofs which allocates arrays proportional to commitment count, causing resource exhaustion.
